title: fee_schedule.updated
description: A registry change to a fee schedule. Every market on it pays the new rates from the next trade; no market.updated is sent for them, so a consumer that caches per-market fees should reload on this event.

changed_fields.description: Which fields the write touched; ["created"] for a new schedule.

version.description: Registry row version after the change; increases on every real change.

reason.description: Operator's reason, recorded in the audit trail.
